name: Astor Enerji A.Ş. (Gecgel family control)
note: BIST-listed transformer maker (ticker ASTOR). Free float about 42.75%; Feridun Gecgel 37.25% of capital / 62.68% of voting rights, brother and deputy chairman Enver Gecgel about 20%. Family has controlled the company since buying Astor Transformatör in 2005.
